title: Mysterian (Prototype)

evidence.layout: Pointer table at CPU $F0F8, 36 phrases, address-ordered, with a final end bound.
evidence.independent_check: The board's own firmware was run and the byte stream it sends the TMS captured and located back in the ROM. It plays 46 streams from 37 distinct addresses spanning $D000-$E961. Every one of those streams falls inside a phrase this layout converts.
evidence.conversion: 1392 frames converted, all keeping their frame kind when the output was re-parsed with the target tables.
evidence.emulation: The converted devices were loaded into a simulation of the Squawk & Talk board, which booted and issued the same 20 SPEAK EXTERNAL commands as the original set.
evidence.not_verified: No converted ROM from this profile has been played on a real board. Nobody has heard it.
evidence.mid_phrase_entry_points: The firmware also starts playback part-way into a phrase, at $DE00. Those addresses are not table entries and need not be: each lies inside a phrase this layout converts, so the bytes played from them are converted bytes.

notes: This sound ROM set is shared by 1 game revisions: mysteria.
